title: Not-found and redirects: Separate missing resources from legitimate redirects: call notFound for absence, redirect for navigation policy, and render real records normally
description: Next.js 16 and TypeScript 5 App Router lesson for not-found and redirects. Includes an intentionally broken starter, a corrected contract, verified-path offline tests and official documentation.
objectives: Separate missing resources from legitimate redirects: call notFound for absence, redirect for navigation policy, and render real records normally.
Repair the intentionally failing next-notfound-redirects model.
Explain which behaviors need real Next.js compilation or browser integration verification.
rubric: I can explain not-found and redirects in Next.js 16 without mixing older Pages Router semantics.
I can reproduce and fix the 07.01.05 failing starter with real data inputs.
I can identify the missing Next.js build, routing and HTTP integration evidence.
